messages:
cleo: quick heads-up — aiming to cut the RC today at 20:00 UTC. short checklist: version bump merged, release notes scrubbed, security review ok, docs merged, qa smoke ✅. who can confirm each?

sam: I have the version bump ready in #4812, just needs one more review and the changelog line. will hold until docs + sec clear.

nisha: docs PR #4900 is live — added upgrade steps and a note about the new cache config. snippet added for ops:

```yaml
server.image: redwood-inference:v0.23.1-rc1
kv_cache.size: 32GB
```

nisha: link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4900 (merged)

derek: QA plan: running smoke runner at 19:30 UTC against staging-rc; will run the API surface checks and a small load sweep (100 concurrent users, 60s). I'll post a short summary after.

release-bot: CI | PR #4812 — unit-tests: ✅, lint: ✅, e2e: running (approx 12m remaining)

sam: changelog needs a concise operator-facing line. @cleo can you add wording for the runtime change?

cleo: added changelog entry: "runtime: improved KV cache eviction to reduce tail latency for prefix-heavy workloads" — posted to #changelogs, also added a short note about rollback steps.

security-bot: security-scan: dependency check found one advisory (CVE-2025-9999) — patched in branch, scanned again, ok. No outstanding blockers.

derek: smoke run done at 19:47 UTC — summary:
- basic endpoints OK
- median token latency 62ms
- p95 token latency 215ms
- failed test: auth-timeout-flaky (investigating) — ticket #4921 created
logs: https://ci.internal/builds/2345/logs

sam: merging #4812 (version bump) in 2 mins after e2e completes. please avoid pushing new release-related PRs to main until canary is stable.

release-bot: e2e for #4812: ✅ (all checks passed) — auto-merge queued

sam: merged #4812 — tagging locally now.

cleo: triggering canary deploy at 20:05 UTC. will monitor for 30m and then either promote or rollback. please @mention if you need a rollback window.

qa-ci: Canary smoke results 20:35 UTC — all smoke checks passed. small uptick in 95p tails on one route but under SLO.

cleo: great. final tag created: v0.23.1-rc1. prepping release note draft and handoff doc. thanks everyone — leaving the canary open for another 15m, then will promote unless objections. :tada:

sam: no objections from me. thanks for the quick turnaround.

nisha: docs follow-up: added a short troubleshooting step for the auth timeout flake.

cleo: promoting to GA candidate in 15. I'll post final release checklist in #release-handoff once promoted.

qa-ci: promotion complete at 20:55 UTC — all post-promote checks green.

cleo: closing the loop — release-ready. :shipit:
